contributions.detail: THIS FILER ITEMIZED EVERYTHING, INCLUDING THE SUB-$50 CONTRIBUTIONS, and the page proves it by a clean two-way partition. All 11 rows sum to 2482.40. Split at the statutory threshold: the seven rows OVER $50 (618.00 + 250.00 + 500.00 + 150.00 + 200.00 + 100.00 + 500.00) sum to exactly 2,318.00 = cover line 1, and the four rows of $50.00 OR LESS (50.00 + 50.00 + 20.00 + 44.40) sum to exactly 164.40 = cover line 2, the aggregate the form says is never itemized. Both cover lines are gated to the cent, which is a far stronger check than either alone. The sub-$50 trap was therefore avoided by scoring the over-$50 SUBSET against line 1 rather than the whole row set. Line 1 and line 2 each read the same in the THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns, and LAST REPORT is 'N/A' on every line, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide — recorded as cumulative. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: 17 rows sum to 2,482.40 = cover line 3 in both the THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns, exact to the cent. THIS SIDE TURNED ON AN ARITHMETIC RULING: at 200 dpi row 7 (Badger Printing, shirts) read as 118.64, which left the page 2.00 OVER the printed total. The disputed glyph was re-cropped at 1200 dpi with contrast normalisation and is a 6, not an 8 — a filled single loop with the same tall entry stroke as the unmistakable '6' two characters later in '.64', where an 8 in this hand is two stacked loops. The document's own arithmetic and the glyph agree on 116.64; no row was adjusted to force closure, and no sibling copy was consulted.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO schedule total and NO page subtotal. p2: 11 rows sum 2,482.40 = cover line 1 (2,318.00) + line 2 (164.40), and the over-$50 SUBSET alone = 2,318.00 = line 1 exactly. p3: 17 rows sum 2,482.40 = cover line 3 exactly. All three gates fire exact.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 -> geometry_status 'ok', 36 bands, deskew 0.6 deg, rules every ~2.31% from 8.18%; the inked transaction rows occupy bands 1-17 ([8.18,10.95] through [45.77,48.09]) and every band from 18 down is empty — 17 rows emitted, matching the ink exactly. rowbands.py p2 -> 'gaps', 33 bands (several rules merged under the handwriting), so p2 was counted by INK: 11 inked writing lines, every line below empty, 11 rows emitted. Field-shift screen: p2 has 11 dates / 11 names / 11 addresses / 11 amounts and p3 has 17 dates / 17 payees / 17 purposes / 17 amounts, with 1:1 vertical alignment on both sheets (this filer does NOT stagger the amount below the name) — passes.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 first-row crop (pct 83.00,8.00,11.00,2.30) renders '618.00'; mid-side control row 6 (pct 83.00,19.85,...) renders '150.00'; last-row crop (pct 83.00,31.70,...) renders '44.40'; control one pitch below (y=34.05%) renders EMPTY. p3 first-row crop (pct 82.50,8.18,10.50,2.77) renders '618.00'; row-7 crop (pct 82.50,22.54,10.50,2.34) renders '116.64' — the disputed cell, landing on its own band; last-row crop (pct 82.50,45.77,10.50,2.32) renders '140.00'; control one pitch below (y=48.09%) renders EMPTY. An earlier p3 pass used estimated bands that were ~1% high and straddled the row-16/17 boundary; the emitted geometry is the rowbands-measured rule grid, re-proved.
gates.balance_chain: 2,318.00 (line 1) + 164.40 (line 2) - 2,482.40 (line 3) = 0, and cover line 4 carries a large SLASHED ZERO glyph in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. Per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling a slashed zero IS 0 (the verbatim glyph is kept in the anchor as 'Ø'), so the chain closes exactly. LAST REPORT column reads 'N/A' on all four lines, so there is no prior filing to chain to.

escalation_note: p1 cover four-line anchor block at 600 dpi (2318.00 / 164.40 / 2482.40 / slashed-zero, and the N/A LAST column); p3 amount column in two 600 dpi crops covering all 17 amounts; p3 row-7 amount cell at 1200 dpi WITH -normalize, the ruling escalation (118.64 vs 116.64); p2 amount column at 600 dpi covering all 11 amounts; p2 name+date column at 600 dpi and the row-3/4/5 date cells at 1200 dpi with -normalize; p3 name/date column in two 600 dpi crops; p3 purpose column in two 600 dpi crops (to read the row-16 ditto); plus 9 geometry-proof crops at 600 dpi.
